case_description: Someone stole my mobile phone from my pocket in a crowded bus.
rephrased_query:

I, [Your Name], being the victim of the theft, hereby lodge this complaint. On [Date and Time] at [Location], while I was on a bus carrying multiple passengers, my personal mobile phone was stolen from my pocket by an unknown person.

Pursuant to Article 13(1) of BNS, I request that the investigating officer take necessary steps to identify the perpetrator and recover the stolen property. Under Section 11(2)(a) of BNSS, I seek the assistance of the police in conducting a thorough investigation to ensure the safe return of my mobile phone.

I request the court to consider this complaint under Article 15(1) of BNS for the purpose of initiating criminal proceedings against the perpetrator and ensuring justice.
